Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you'll do

Design and implement a comprehensive risk management strategy emphasizing early risk detection, automated alert systems, incident response, and continuous improvement. Conduct thorough risk assessments focused on operational and technology risks, identifying vulnerabilities, and recommending mitigations. Support Risk Exposure Reporting, regulatory reviews, and updates to the Risk Management Program to meet evolving business and regulatory needs. Implement automated alert mechanisms for risk limit breaches, unusual trading patterns, and system anomalies. Leverage advanced analytics tools to uncover risk trends and provide actionable insights for decision-making.     • Develop real-time or near–real-time monitoring and alerting systems that detect risk limit breaches, unusual trading activity, or system anomalies;
    • Execute control testing programs for risk mitigation;
    • Perform advanced statistical analytics on large structured datasets utilizing Python or similar programming tools to identify trends and quantify risk exposures;
    • Utilize industry-standard business intelligence or visualization platforms (Looker, Superset, Tableau, or PowerBI) to build dashboards, trend analyses, and key risk metric reporting; and
    • Investigate complex risk scenarios and develop mitigation strategies aligned with industry regulatory standards.

descriptions.job-108yqv5:
About Riot Platforms

Riot’s (NASDAQ: RIOT) vision is to be the world’s most trusted platform for powering and building digital infrastructure. Riot’s mission is to empower the future of digital infrastructure by positively impacting the sectors, networks, and communities that we touch. We believe that the combination of an innovative spirit and strong community partnership allows us to achieve best-in-class execution and create successful outcomes.

Who we are

At Riot, we’re building the future of digital infrastructure. Our team members have unparalleled opportunities to work on groundbreaking initiatives. Through technical excellence and strategic execution, Riot has positioned itself as a leader in the industry driving advancements that continue to set new benchmarks in digital infrastructure. 

We are trailblazers. Problem solvers. People who thrive in fast paced environments, communicate clearly, and bring relentless focus to efficiency and execution.

About the role

Riot Platforms is seeking a Director of Identity & Access Management (IAM) to lead the strategy, architecture, engineering, and operations of our enterprise identity security program.

As Riot continues its evolution toward large-scale AI/HPC and data center operations, identity will be a foundational security control across our corporate, cloud, data center, and operational environments. This leader will be responsible for establishing a modern, scalable IAM program centered on Zero Trust, least privilege, strong authentication, privileged access management, identity governance, and automation.

The Director of IAM will report into Cybersecurity and partner closely with IT, Infrastructure, Cloud, Data Center Operations, People Operations, GRC, and business leaders.

 

This is a remote position with travel to Riot sites as needed.

What you'll be doing

  • Develop and execute Riot’s enterprise IAM strategy and roadmap across workforce, privileged, third-party, and non-human identities.
  • Own the architecture and security of Microsoft Entra ID, including SSO, Conditional Access, MFA, passwordless authentication, PIM, RBAC, and identity lifecycle controls.
  • Mature Riot’s Privileged Access Management (PAM) program and eliminate unnecessary standing administrative privileges.
  • Establish scalable Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) capabilities for joiner/mover/leaver processes, access reviews, entitlement management, and segregation of duties.
  • Implement least privilege and role-based access models across enterprise, cloud, SaaS, and data center environments.
  • Develop governance for service accounts, API identities, machine identities, certificates, secrets, and other non-human identities.
  • Establish secure and repeatable processes for vendors, contractors, partners, and other third-party access.
  • Increase IAM automation and reduce manual provisioning, approval delays, and unnecessary user friction.
  • Define IAM standards, architecture patterns, controls, and security requirements for new technology implementations.
  • Partner with Cybersecurity Operations to detect and respond to identity-based attacks, credential compromise, privilege escalation, and anomalous authentication activity.
  • Define measurable IAM KPIs and KRIs and regularly communicate program maturity, risks, and progress to leadership.
  • Ensure IAM controls support Riot’s SOX, SOC 2 and ISO 27001, regulatory, audit, and broader security requirements.
  • Lead IAM engineers and partners while developing the talent and capabilities needed as Riot’s environment grows.

What you'll have

  • 10+ years of cybersecurity, IAM, infrastructure security, or related experience, including significant leadership responsibility.
  • Demonstrated experience building or materially transforming an enterprise IAM program.
  • Strong understanding of Zero Trust, least privilege, identity governance, PAM, authentication, authorization, and identity lifecycle management.
  • Experience securing hybrid environments spanning on-premises infrastructure, cloud platforms, SaaS applications, and modern data center environments.
  • Ability to translate identity risks and complex technical issues into clear business decisions.
  • Strong experience partnering across Cybersecurity, IT, HR/People Operations, GRC, Infrastructure, and business teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to balance security, operational efficiency, and user experience.
  • Preferred experience supporting data centers, critical infrastructure, AI/HPC, or OT environments.
  • Preferred experience implementing identity automation at enterprise scale.
  • Preferred familiarity with SOX, SOC 2, ISO, NIST CSF, Zero Trust architecture, and related control frameworks.
  • Preferred experience designing identity controls for cloud workloads and non-human identities.
  • Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, Microsoft Identity, highly preferred.

Compensation and Benefits 

  • Competitive Salary: $180,000-$200,000 base salary (commensurate with experience) + bonus + sign-on equity grant. 
  • Long-Term Growth: Eligible to participate in Riot’s equity incentive programs and share in the success you help build. 
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan: Incudes a generous company match. 
  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Multiple medical plan options, including 100% company-paid plans. 
  • Wellness & Lifestyle Perks: Enjoy free gym memberships, pet insurance, childcare discounts, and more to support your life both in and out of work. 

Riot is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

  • Experience taking a product or product marketing function from zero to one. You've built positioning, launches, and sales materials when the audience, category, or playbook was still being defined.

  • A track record supporting a sales-led motion. You've worked directly with sellers and technical partners on real opportunities, and can point to messaging and materials that helped customers make a buying decision.

  • Strong customer research instincts. You can show how customer conversations changed your positioning, challenged an assumption, or led you to focus on a different use case.

  • Technical fluency and curiosity. You can learn a complex product, explain how it works, and earn credibility with developers and researchers while making its value clear to a business buyer.

  • Excellent writing and strong editorial judgment. You can turn a dense technical discussion into a clear story without losing what makes the product distinctive.

  • Demonstrated, hands-on use of AI tools and agents in your work. We'll ask you to show us how you work.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward shipping. You can choose what matters, produce a strong first version, and improve it as evidence comes in.

Bonus

  • Experience with AI/ML infrastructure, post-training, reinforcement learning, evaluations, or agent platforms.

  • Experience helping define an emerging category or repositioning a technical product as the product and market evolved.

  • A technical background, hands-on product experience, or experience building a customer advisory or design-partner program.

What We Offer

  • Competitive cash compensation and meaningful equity

  • Visa sponsorship and relocation support

  • Professional development budget

  • Team off-sites and conference attendance

  • The opportunity to help shape the market for open AI infrastructure

About the Job

This role builds a canonical entity and knowledge graph across Intelligence Core connectors to resolve identities (people, agents, systems, data entities). The entity layer supports data classification at the source to unify transaction reporting.

Core Objective: Automate system-level identity, authority and permissions.

Strategic Importance: Underpins security, core authority models, registers, and kill switches internally, while providing the foundation for agentic commerce credentials externally.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the classify-at-source pilot with Finance and Compliance to establish unified tag models and metrics without re-derivation.
  • Establish shadow-AI and agent-identity registers to define ownership, access controls, and data permissions.
  • Build entity resolution pipelines across internal systems (Slack, Jira, Ironclad) using privacy-preserving linkage and canonical IDs.
  • Develop graph-based correlation skills (e.g., Jira gap-finder) and establish verifiable baseline metrics for operational throughput and SAR false positives.
  • Ground operational agents in the shared graph to deliver unified event tracking, reasoning, and real-time authorization.
  • Define graph architecture, governing schemas, temporal permissions, and provenance tracking to ensure full auditability and agent compatibility.
  • Maintain data accuracy using bitemporal modeling, automated drift detection, and historical replay capabilities for compliance.
  • Model delegation chains and agent credentials anchored to human principals for secure external interoperability.
  • Deploy ML and graph-native methods to analyze multi-agent behaviors, detect anomalies, and identify shared lineage or prompts.
  • Evaluate and integrate emerging graph and identity resolution research.
  • Enforce strict regulatory compliance, jurisdictional data partitioning, and privacy-by-design standards across the identity layer.

Requirements

  • Direct experience with entity resolution, identity systems or knowledge-graph modelling.
  • Strong Python plus graph or relational data engineering in production.
  • Applied ML for resolution at scale, potentially including embedding- and LLM-based matching, self-supervised and active-learning loops, with the discipline to benchmark before trusting, on synthetic or de-identified sets, since raw PII never enters an evaluation.
  • Schema and API design for heterogeneous consumers, human and machine.
  • Comfort working directly with Finance and Compliance colleagues on a live data pilot from the first weeks.
  • Security and privacy by design as a working habit: an identity layer in an MSB/VASP environment is regulated surface, and you design accordingly.
  • Comfort building a foundational layer whose consumers don't exist yet.

Benefits

  • Healthcare Insurance: zerohash covers roughly 100% of employee premiums as well as a portion of spouse/children (U.S. only)
  • Vision & Dental Insurance (U.S. only)
  • Chance to earn equity
  • Maternity & Paternity leave (after 6 months)

  • Define the Growth Strategy and Business Opportunity —

Develop customer segments and conversion funnels, and turn insights into clear product, positioning, and lifecycle opportunities.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

  • We are looking for an experienced Senior Manager, Settlement & Reconciliation to lead and enhance our settlement and reconciliation operations across both digital assets and fiat.
  • This role requires more than strong settlement operational experience. The ideal candidate should have a solid understanding of trading and settlement system architecture, including how settlement systems interact with trading platforms, transaction data, custody/banking infrastructure, and finance/accounting systems.
  • The role will serve as a key bridge between Finance, Settlement Operations, Product, Engineering, and other relevant stakeholders, translating settlement and accounting requirements into clear system, data, and reporting requirements.
  • Candidates with experience in traditional financial markets, securities, banking, brokerage, clearing, custody, or other transaction-intensive financial institutions are highly preferred.
 
  • The successful candidate will build a settlement and reconciliation function that is not only operationally effective, but also system-driven, highly reconcilable, and finance-ready.
  • The individual should be able to understand a transaction from execution through settlement, reconciliation, and ultimately financial accounting, and work across Operations, Finance, Product, Data, and Engineering to ensure that the underlying processes and systems are scalable, controlled, and transparent.
 

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Settlement Operations
    - Lead and oversee day-to-day settlement operations across digital asset and fiat transactions.
    - Ensure transactions are settled accurately, completely, and within the required timelines.
    - Establish and continuously improve settlement procedures, controls, exception handling, and escalation mechanisms.
    - Identify settlement breaks, operational risks, and process inefficiencies, and drive timely resolution.
    - Support new products, transaction flows, and business models by assessing their settlement and operational requirements.
  • Settlement System & System Architecture
    - Develop a strong understanding of the end-to-end settlement system architecture and transaction data flow.
    - Understand how settlement systems interface with:
      - Trading systems and order/transaction engines;
      - Wallet, custody, and blockchain infrastructure;
      - Fiat banking and payment systems;
      - Data warehouse and reporting platforms; and
      - Finance, accounting, and general ledger systems.
    - Work closely with Product and Engineering teams to define settlement-related system requirements.
    - Translate operational and finance requirements into clear and actionable data, system, and reporting specifications for Engineering teams.
    - Define the reports, data fields, transaction-level information, and reconciliation logic required to support settlement operations and financial accounting.
    - Participate in system implementation, enhancement, UAT, and post-implementation validation from a settlement and finance-control perspective.
  • Digital Asset Reconciliation
    - Own and oversee Digital Asset (DA) reconciliation, including reconciliation among customer balances, internal ledgers, wallet/on-chain balances, custody records, and other relevant source systems.
    - Investigate and resolve reconciliation differences, including transaction timing differences, system exceptions, missing transactions, and data inconsistencies.
    - Work with Product, Engineering, Data, Wallet, and Finance teams to identify root causes and implement sustainable remediation.
    - Establish appropriate reconciliation controls and monitoring mechanisms to ensure completeness and accuracy of digital asset balances and movements.
  • Fiat Reconciliation
    - Own and oversee Fiat reconciliation across customer balances, banking/custodian records, payment channels, internal operational systems, and the general ledger.
    - Ensure customer fiat assets and liabilities can be reconciled to relevant operational and accounting records.
    - Investigate reconciliation breaks and coordinate with Finance, Fiat Operations, Product, Engineering, banks, custodians, and payment service providers for resolution.
    - Drive automation and system improvements to reduce manual reconciliation and operational dependency.
  • Customer Transaction Reconciliation
    - Oversee transaction-level reconciliation covering customer trades, deposits, withdrawals, transfers, settlements, and other relevant transaction activities.
    - Ensure customer transaction records can be traced consistently across trading, settlement, operational, and accounting systems.
    - Establish effective exception-management processes for unmatched or incomplete transactions.
    - Support Finance and external audit requirements by ensuring transaction data and reconciliation evidence are complete, accurate, and traceable.
  •  Finance & Accounting Support
    - Partner closely with Finance to ensure settlement data and reports provide sufficient information for accurate and timely accounting.
    - Understand how trading and settlement activities ultimately flow into financial records and the general ledger.
    - Define operational reports and data outputs required by Finance for:
      - Accounting entries;
      - Period-end closing;
      - Balance sheet reconciliation;
      - Customer asset and liability reconciliation; and
      - Financial and external audit support.
    - Identify gaps between operational systems and accounting requirements and work with relevant teams to develop scalable solutions.
  • Process, Control & Team Management
    - Build and maintain robust settlement and reconciliation SOPs, controls, and governance frameworks.
    - Drive automation and process improvements to improve settlement efficiency, accuracy, scalability, and control.
    - Establish key operational metrics and monitor settlement exceptions, reconciliation breaks, aging items, and resolution timelines.
    - Manage and develop the settlement team, ensuring clear ownership, effective prioritization, and strong execution.
    - Act as a senior escalation point for complex settlement, reconciliation, and transaction-related issues.
    - Collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders across Finance, Product, Engineering, Data, Operations, Risk, Compliance, and other relevant teams.
 

What We Look For In You

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
  • Significant experience in settlement, clearing, reconciliation, transaction operations, custody, or related financial operations, with experience in a managerial or senior leadership role.
  • Strong experience with customer transaction reconciliation and transaction-level data analysis.
  • Solid understanding of trading lifecycle and settlement processes.
  • Prior experience in traditional financial institutions, such as banks, securities firms, broker-dealers, exchanges, clearing houses, custodians, payment institutions, or other transaction-intensive financial businesses.
  • Strong understanding of how trading systems, settlement systems, reconciliation platforms, and accounting systems interact.
  • Ability to understand system and data architecture and translate operational or finance requirements into clear requirements for Product and Engineering teams.
  • Strong experience in designing or defining operational reports, reconciliation reports, and transaction-level data requirements.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex reconciliation differences and identify root causes.
  • Strong understanding of operational controls, data completeness, accuracy, and transaction traceability.
  • Excellent stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with both Finance and technical teams.
  • Strong ownership mindset and ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced and evolving business environment.
 

Nice to Haves

  • Experience in cryptocurrency, digital assets, exchanges, fintech, brokerage, or other high-volume transaction platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with digital asset / wallet / on-chain reconciliation.
  • Experience with fiat payment, banking, custodian, or payment-service-provider reconciliation.
  • Experience participating in settlement or reconciliation system implementation and transformation projects.
  • Experience working with Product and Engineering teams on system design, data requirements, reporting logic, UAT, and process automation.
  • Familiarity with accounting systems, general ledger processes, and period-end financial reconciliation.
  • Experience supporting internal or external audit requests relating to transaction completeness, settlement, or reconciliation.
  • SQL, data analytics, or other data-querying experience would be an advantage.
 

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
  • Various team building programs and company events
  • Wellness and meal allowances 
  • Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants 
  • More that we love to tell you along the process!

  • Seek Excellence.

Who You Are

The Data Center Business Operations Manager is responsible for building, implementing, and continuously improving the operating frameworks, processes, and services that enable the business to operate consistently and effectively across locations and functions.

This role owns the development of enterprise-level business operations standards, including processes, procedures, governance, taxonomy, naming conventions, documentation standards, tools, and operating expectations that Project Managers and business teams use across the organization.

The Business Operations Manager partners closely with Finance, Procurement, Legal, HR, IT, and other corporate functions to translate company requirements into practical processes that meet the needs of the business and can be effectively implemented at the site and functional level.

The Business Operations Manager also leads the development and management of Workplace Services programs that require consistency and coordination across the organization, including vehicle fleet, uniforms, transportation services, culinary programs, and other shared operational services.

The Business Operations Manager establishes the program strategy, standards, processes, and expectations, while onsite Project Managers and local teams are responsible for implementing and managing those programs at the site level.

This role requires someone who can move fluidly between strategy and execution: designing scalable enterprise processes, partnering with corporate functions, building operational programs, and ensuring those programs can be successfully implemented in the field.

What You’ll Do

Business Operations & Enterprise Standards

  • Design, implement, and continuously improve enterprise-level business operations processes, procedures, workflows, governance standards, templates, tools, and operating expectations.
  • Establish and maintain consistent standards for how information is organized and managed, including taxonomy, naming conventions, documentation standards, project structures, reporting conventions, and other common ways of working.
  • Develop scalable frameworks and playbooks that Project Managers and business teams can use to execute work consistently across departments, projects, and locations.
  • Identify recurring friction, process gaps, unclear ownership, inefficient handoffs, and inconsistencies across the business and implement scalable solutions.
  • Create documentation, training, and implementation guidance that enables Project Managers and business teams to understand and consistently apply established processes and standards.
  • Monitor adoption and effectiveness of business operations processes and standards, identifying gaps and driving continuous improvement as business needs evolve.

Cross-Functional Process & Project Support

  • Partner with Finance and Procurement on the development and rollout of processes related to budgeting, forecasting, purchasing, vendor management, financial controls, and other requirements.

  • Establish clear engagement models, workflows, roles, responsibilities, and escalation paths so Project Managers and business teams understand when and how to engage Finance, Procurement, Legal, and other support functions.

Workplace Services Programs

  • Build and oversee enterprise Workplace Services programs that support consistent, efficient operations across locations.
  • Establish the strategy, standards, processes, service expectations, and governance for programs such as vehicle fleet, uniforms, transportation services, culinary services, onsite office space and other shared workplace or operational services.
  • Partner with Procurement, Finance, Legal, and other stakeholders to establish appropriate vendor strategies, contracts, budgets, controls, and service-level expectations for Workplace Services programs.
  • Develop enterprise playbooks and implementation standards for Workplace Services programs, providing clear direction to onsite Project Managers and local teams responsible for execution.
  • Monitor program performance, service quality, cost, compliance, and business needs across locations and continuously improve programs as the organization evolves.

Project Management Standards & Governance

Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.


Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Payward Services is an enterprise infrastructure platform that enables companies to seamlessly integrate trading, payments, funding, and digital asset services through a single unified system. It provides coordinated liquidity, custody, compliance, risk management, and settlement capabilities, reducing operational complexity for fintechs, banks, brokerages, and payment providers.

Payward's Payments & Blockchain team owns the first and last mile of every dollar that moves in or out of its products. That means dozens of banking partners, PSPs and local rails powering deposits and withdrawals for millions of users.

The team is looking for a product manager to shape the future of this platform, from the architecture underneath to the API layer internal clients build on. At the center is Payward's in-house PSP: a scalable, multi-tenant payments backend with hosted pages, SDKs, embedded components and direct APIs, so any Payward business can plug in and reach pay-in and payout rails worldwide.

 

The opportunity

  • Own the product vision and roadmap for the Payward payments platform, covering both the shared backend and the integration surfaces internal clients build on (hosted pages, SDKs, embedded components and direct APIs)

  • Map requirements across internal clients and use them to evolve the platform's vision and capabilities so it serves a growing range of use cases

  • Partner with engineering to turn the target vision into a sequenced, high-impact roadmap, with milestones every client team can plan against

  • Prioritize across competing client needs, make the trade-offs visible, and say no with a clear rationale

  • Shape the client experience end to end, from first conversation to go-live, so teams can adopt the platform without heavy hand-holding

  • Work with the banking and partnerships teams so each new PSP or bank integration is built once on the platform and reaches every Payward business

  • Bring compliance, risk and legal requirements across Payward's entities and jurisdictions into the roadmap early, before they become launch blockers

  • Set and track platform success metrics, such as time to launch a rail for an existing client, time for a new client to go live, share of rails available through the platform, and payment success rates

 
 

What you bring

  • 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in a platform, API or infrastructure role where your customers were other internal teams or developers

  • Working knowledge of payments: pay-ins and payouts, PSPs and acquirers, bank rails (ACH, SEPA, Faster Payments, SWIFT and local methods), and how money flows between them

  • Strong technical fluency. You can read an RFC, challenge an architecture decision, and write an API spec that engineers respect

  • Experience shipping developer-facing products such as APIs, SDKs, or embeddable UI components

  • Clear, structured writing. You turn complex system designs into docs that product, compliance and business stakeholders can all act on

  • Skill at managing many stakeholders with different priorities, and building alignment without direct authority

  • Comfort working with data to set goals and measure platform adoption and performance

 
 

Nice to haves

  • Experience at a PSP, payment orchestrator or payments infrastructure company, or building one in-house

  • Background with multi-tenant SaaS or B2B2C platforms

  • Familiarity with crypto, stablecoins or on/off-ramps

  • Experience working across multiple regulated legal entities or licensing regimes

## About Polymarket

Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future.

We're growing fast, both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire.

## About the Role

The CX team at Polymarket is small, high-ownership, and directly responsible for the experience of users moving real money on the world's largest prediction market. Right now, the team handles a high volume of complex issues across withdrawals, KYC, and market resolution, and the data infrastructure to understand that work at scale is still being built. That's where this role comes in.

We're hiring a senior analytics engineer to own the data foundation for CX. You'll build the models, pipelines, and semantic layer that turn raw support data into something the team can actually use. This isn't a role where you inherit a clean system and maintain it. You'll be making foundational decisions about how CX data is structured, sourced, and trusted, and those decisions will shape how the team operates for years.

This matters because CX data at Polymarket is genuinely complex. Users interact across crypto rails, prediction markets, and identity verification flows, and the failure modes are varied and often novel. The person in this role needs to understand that complexity well enough to model it correctly, and to communicate clearly with both engineers and non-technical CX teammates about what the data does and doesn't show.

## What You'll Do

  • Design and maintain dbt data models for support data, covering ticketing, KYC, withdrawals, and market resolution workflows
  • Integrate data from sources including Decagon, BPO partners, CRM systems, and WFM tools into the cloud warehouse
  • Build data quality tests, monitoring, and documentation so the team can trust what they're looking at
  • Define shared metrics and dimensions in the semantic layer so CX, ops, and leadership are all calculating things the same way
  • Build dashboards and self-serve datasets that let CX teammates answer operational questions without waiting on a data request
  • Identify recurring failure patterns in support data and translate them into documented findings for the CX playbook and internal stakeholders
  • Partner with the central data engineering team on shared pipelines, infrastructure decisions, and data governance

## What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a closely related data role
  • Expert SQL and strong hands-on dbt experience, including modeling, testing, and documentation
  • Experience working with a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift
  • Experience with data ingestion tools such as Fivetran or Airbyte, and working knowledge of Python
  • Strong data modeling fundamentals and a track record of building systems that non-technical teams actually use
  • Experience diagnosing complex, multi-variable issues and communicating findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders
  • Track record of building or improving documentation, whether data documentation, support playbooks, or process guides
  • (Plus) Prior experience working with customer support, CRM, or trust and safety data
  • (Plus) Experience influencing product or policy decisions using data from CX or operations
  • (Plus) Familiarity with on-chain data or crypto transaction flows

## Benefits

  • Competitive salary & equity
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage
  • 401k match
  • Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories

Pay Transparency

Base salary range: $200,000 to $250,000, plus equity and benefits.

This is a good-faith range for the level we're hiring at. Experience varies widely within a title here, so if your expectations fall outside it, reach out anyway. We're always happy to talk it through.

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Proof of work

 

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

The Agent Systems team is a 0→1 engineering group building internal AI-powered agents that interact directly with company systems. The mandate is to dramatically increase internal speed of execution through automation, intelligent inference, and workflow orchestration.

This team operates at the intersection of AI, backend systems, and applied product engineering. The work is pragmatic and fast-moving — prototypes are expected, but the bar for production reliability remains high. Engineers on this team move fluidly between experimentation and shipping, building systems that reason over user interactions and take meaningful action across internal tools.

You’ll work closely with cross-functional partners across product, infrastructure, and internal operations to deploy agent-driven capabilities that compound leverage across the organization.

 

The opportunity

  • Build and ship AI-powered agent systems that automate internal workflows and decision paths

  • Design and implement inference pipelines that reason over user interactions across internal systems

  • Prototype quickly to validate agent behaviors, then productionize what proves valuable

  • Architect backend services that integrate with multiple internal APIs and data sources

  • Define patterns for safe, observable, and controllable agent execution

  • Collaborate cross-functionally to identify high-leverage automation opportunities

  • Improve system speed, reliability, and signal quality as usage scales

  • Contribute to foundational design decisions for a 0→1 agent platform

 

Skills you should HODL

  • 5+ years of experience building and shipping production software systems

  • Strong backend engineering fundamentals (APIs, distributed systems, data modeling, reliability)

  • Experience building fullstack systems, with comfort working across backend and occasional frontend surfaces

  • Hands-on experience working with AI/ML systems, LLMs, or inference pipelines in production

  • Ability to prototype rapidly while maintaining a clear path to production-grade architecture

  • Strong systems thinking — able to reason about orchestration, failure modes, and observability

  • Comfort operating in ambiguous, 0→1 environments with high ownership

 

Nice to haves

  • Experience building or operating agent-based systems or autonomous workflows

  • Familiarity with prompt engineering, evaluation frameworks, or model performance tuning

  • Experience integrating with internal enterprise systems (CRM, support tools, analytics platforms, etc.)

  • Background in building developer platforms or internal tooling

  • Experience designing guardrails, sandboxing, or safety layers for AI systems

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

In this role, you’ll:

  • Serve as the primary liaison to key policy and regulatory stakeholders across Singapore, Australia, South Korea, and Japan, including MAS, AUSTRAC, FSC/FSS, JFSA, relevant ministries, and law enforcement agencies

  • Develop and execute market-specific policy and regulatory engagement strategies that position Chainalysis as a trusted partner on digital assets, AML/CTF, and financial crime

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with regulators and government officials, contributing expertise through consultations, roundtables, and public–private partnerships

  • Represent Chainalysis in regional policy, legislative, and regulatory discussions, acting as a spokesperson on relevant issues

  • Draft and coordinate responses to regulatory consultations, proposed rules, and legislative reforms across priority markets

  • Monitor regulatory and policy developments across the region and provide clear, actionable analysis and recommendations to internal stakeholders

  • Partner closely with APAC leadership, government solutions, and account teams to identify engagement opportunities and advance strategic policy objectives

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Engineering, Sales, and Marketing to ensure products, messaging, and go-to-market strategies align with local regulatory expectations

We’re looking for candidates who have:

  • Significant experience in public policy, regulatory affairs, government relations, or financial crime within financial services, fintech, digital assets, or related sectors

  • Direct experience engaging with financial regulators and government stakeholders in APAC, particularly in Singapore, Australia, South Korea, and/or Japan

  • Strong understanding of AML/CTF, financial crime, cybercrime, or regulatory frameworks and their impact on technology-enabled businesses
    Demonstrated understanding of and interest in digital assets and their regulatory, compliance, and enforcement implications

  • Proven ability to establish credibility, trust, and confidence with senior government officials and regulators, operating effectively as an advisor and counselor

  • Track record of supporting and executing successful regulatory or government affairs initiatives that deliver enterprise-wide impact, including building partnerships between public and private sector entities

  • Experience representing an organisation externally, including participation in regulatory consultations, industry forums, and public–private partnerships
    Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience producing policy papers, consultation responses, and executive-level briefings

  • Experience working cross-functionally with legal, product, engineering, sales, and commercial teams in a global or matrixed organisation

Nice To Have Experience

  • Advanced degree in public policy, international affairs, law, economics, or a related field

  • Professional experience related to digital asset regulation, public policy, financial crimes, cybercrime, tax, traditional financial services, financial consumer protection, or closely related areas aligned to Chainalysis’s business

  • Prior experience working at or closely with regulators such as MAS, AUSTRAC, FSC/FSS, JFSA, or other relevant government agencies

  • Experience supporting regulatory strategy across multiple APAC jurisdictions

  • Experience managing external advisors, industry associations, or strategic policy alliances

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Payroll Specialist to take ownership of the accurate, timely and fully compliant delivery of payroll in India, and to act as a second pair of hands across our Asia-Pacific and Middle East payrolls. Reporting to the UK-based Head of Payroll and working day to day alongside the Senior Payroll Specialist in the UK, you will be the resident subject-matter expert on Indian payroll legislation and statutory obligations within a global, follow-the-sun payroll team.


India payroll is delivered through a managed-service provider. Your role is not to key transactions into a system: it is to own the inputs, interrogate the outputs, hold the vendor to account, evidence the controls and stand behind every number that reaches employees, the regulator and the general ledger. This is a regulated financial services environment where confidentiality, accuracy and a demonstrable audit trail are non-negotiable.


Key responsibilities

India payroll delivery

  • Own the end-to-end monthly India payroll cycle — calendar, cut-offs, inputs, validation, approval, funding, disbursement and post-payroll reconciliation.
  • Prepare, validate and submit payroll inputs covering new hires, leavers, transfers, promotions, salary revisions, variable pay, bonuses, allowances, reimbursements, loans, advances and recoveries.
  • Review the vendor’s gross-to-net output in detail; investigate and resolve every variance against prior period before sign-off, rather than relying on vendor assurance.
  • Manage full and final settlements for leavers, including notice pay, leave encashment, gratuity, recovery of advances and correct tax treatment.
  • Own the annual cycle: investment declarations and proof verification, Form 16 issuance, Form 24Q filings, perquisite valuation, and the transition between the old and new tax regimes.
  • Maintain the payroll calendar and ensure all statutory and internal deadlines are met without exception.

India statutory compliance

  • You will be expected to operate independently on all of the following, and to be the person the wider team turns to when a question of Indian payroll law arises:
  • Provident Fund (EPF/EPS/EDLI): contribution calculation, wage-ceiling application, international worker rules, UAN management, monthly ECR filing,
  • National Pension System (NPS): corporate NPS administration, employer and employee contribution handling, PRAN management and the associated tax deductions and exemptions.
  • Income tax and state-level taxes: TDS computation and deposit, quarterly eTDS returns, Labour Welfare Fund, and state-specific obligations across every state in which the entity employs staff.
  • Professional Tax: registration, slab application and remittance across multiple states, with awareness that rates, slabs and due dates differ by state and change frequently.
  • ESI and Gratuity: eligibility assessment, contribution and accrual, and coordination with Finance on provisioning.
  • Labour Codes: tracking the phased implementation of the four Labour Codes and associated central and state rules, modelling the impact of the wage-definition changes on statutory costs, and preparing the payroll for each change.

Sickness, maternity and absence

  • Administer maternity benefit in line with the Maternity Benefit Act — eligibility, 26-week paid entitlement, adoption and commissioning-mother provisions, ESI interaction and correct payroll treatment throughout the leave period.
  • Administer paternity, sickness, casual, earned and other statutory and company leave, including accrual, carry-forward, encashment and unpaid-leave recoveries.
  • Process sickness absence and long-term absence cases, including any ESI cash-benefit interaction, and ensure returns to work are reflected accurately and promptly in pay.
  • Act as a sensitive and discreet point of contact for employees on leave-related pay queries, working closely with HR Business Partners on complex or confidential cases.

Regional support — Singapore, Hong Kong, Japan and the UAE

  • Provide preparation, checking and review support for the Singapore, Hong Kong, Japan and UAE payrolls, working to the standards set by the Head of Payroll and the UK Senior Payroll Specialist.
  • Build working knowledge of the local statutory frameworks in Singapore;  Hong Kong; Japan; and in the UAE.
  • Provide holiday, peak-period and absence cover for regional payrolls, offering genuine resilience rather than nominal back-up.
  • Support in-country vendors and advisers with input preparation, query resolution and validation of statutory outputs.

Vendor, controls and governance

  • Manage the day-to-day relationship with the India payroll provider: service levels, issue escalation, root-cause analysis and continuous improvement.
  • Operate and evidence the payroll control framework — maker-checker, reconciliations, approval thresholds, segregation of duties and change control — to a standard that withstands internal audit and regulatory scrutiny.
  • Reconcile payroll to the general ledger; prepare journals, accruals and funding requests, and resolve differences with Finance.
  • Support internal and external audit, statutory audit and regulatory requests with complete, well-organised evidence.
  • Handle all employee and payroll data in strict accordance with data protection obligations and internal confidentiality policy.

Stakeholders, reporting and improvement

  • Resolve employee payroll queries professionally and within agreed service levels, escalating judgement calls appropriately.
  • Partner with HR, Finance, Reward, Tax and Mobility on compensation changes, cross-border assignments, equity and deferred-compensation payments.
  • Produce payroll reporting, cost analysis and statutory returns for management and for the business.
  • Identify and deliver process improvements, automation and stronger controls; support payroll system implementations, vendor transitions and entity or country onboarding.
  • Maintain accurate, current desktop procedures and process documentation for every payroll you touch.

Skills and personal attributes

  • Accuracy and ownership. You treat a payroll error as a serious matter, check your own work before anyone else has to, and are accountable for what you sign off.
  • Discretion. You handle salary, bonus and personal circumstances data with complete professionalism.
  • Deadline discipline. Payroll dates do not move; you plan backwards from them and flag risk early.
  • Investigative mindset. You are not satisfied by a number that looks approximately right — you find out why it changed.
  • Clear communication. You can explain a statutory deduction plainly to an employee and technically to an auditor.
  • Remote collaboration. You work effectively across time zones with a small, senior, UK-based team and manage your own workload without close supervision.
  • Adaptability. Indian payroll legislation is in a period of significant change; you keep current and act on it.

Additional information

This role sits within a small global payroll team and offers exposure to payroll across Asia-Pacific, the Middle East and the UK. Some flexibility will be required around payroll cut-off dates and to accommodate overlap with the UK working day.

Work Experience/ Background:

Essential

  • A minimum of 5 years’ hands-on experience running end-to-end payroll in India, including full ownership of at least one monthly cycle from inputs to reconciliation.
  • Strong, current and demonstrable knowledge of Indian payroll legislation: Provident Fund, NPS, income tax and TDS, Professional Tax and state-level taxes, ESI, gratuity, bonus and Labour Welfare Fund.
  • Practical experience administering Professional Tax and other state-level obligations across multiple Indian states.
  • Proven experience of sickness, maternity and statutory leave administration and its payroll treatment.
  • Experience working with an outsourced payroll provider — reviewing and challenging vendor output rather than accepting it.
  • Confident, accurate gross-to-net and variance analysis; the ability to explain any individual payslip line by line.
  • Strong Excel skills (lookups, pivots, large-volume reconciliation) and familiarity with payroll and HR systems such as Workday
  • Experience operating within a documented control environment with audit evidence requirements.
  • Fluent written and spoken English, with the confidence to work directly with UK-based colleagues and senior stakeholders.

Desirable

  • Working knowledge of payroll and statutory requirements in one or more of Singapore (CPF, IR8A/IR21), Hong Kong (MPF, IR56 series), Japan (social insurance, resident tax, year-end adjustment) and the UAE (WPS, end-of-service gratuity, GPSSA).
  • Prior experience in financial services, professional services or another regulated, confidentiality-sensitive environment.
  • Experience supporting expatriate and internationally mobile populations, shadow payroll, tax equalisation or hypothetical tax.
  • Experience with equity, carried interest, deferred compensation or bonus-heavy pay structures.
  • Involvement in payroll implementations, vendor transitions or process automation projects.
  • Professional qualification or part-qualification in accounting, HR or payroll (for example CIPP, CA Inter, CMA, MBA (HR)), or an equivalent Indian payroll certification.
